## Norms
<hr>

:::{.compact-font}
| In person norms | And also, for online learning... |
|----------|----------|
| Be fully present to each other & the work. | Keep your video on when possible. In large groups, mute your microphone when not talking. Close/mute/minimize other apps and devices to avoid distraction. |
| Assume positive intent & also take responsibility for the impact you have. | Remember online interaction masks even more of the full story. Notice when you are making assumptions, and seek information to check them. |
| Embrace collaboration. | Use the gallery view so you can see everyone. Use breakout groups as an opportunity to collaborate. |
| Be open to learning and accept non-closure. | Expect the inevitable technical glitches and learning curves. Exercise patience with one another. |
| Be aware of when to step up and step back. When stepping back, do so as an active listener. | Try out different modes of participation. Step back by making space for others to engage in these. |
| Land your plane--get to the point you intended. | We all know how hard it is to be talked at, especially in a Zoom session, so let's keep it to a minimum. |

:::

## Praise, Question, Polish (PQP)
<hr>
- a structured way to provide feedback
- Note: feedback survey has sentence starters
    - Praise: What did you like? (~1.5 min)
    - Question: What did you wonder/need clarified? (~1.5 min)
    - Polish: What could be improved? (form only)

## AI Policy
<hr>

:::{.smaller-font}
This course has a mixed use policy for Generative AI. Note that multiple models are now available to UTK students for free via the UT AI Hub. Specifically, Gen AI may be used to analyze and troubleshoot code *after* you have already manually written it. To maintain academic integrity, students who use Gen AI to analyze and troubleshoot code must disclose such use.

A student should include the following statement in each question where a Generative AI tool was used to analyze and/or troubleshoot code. Again, this statement should be used within each question where AI assistance was used:

:::{.gray-box}
“I acknowledge the use of [Generative AI Tool Name: Claude/Gemini/ChatGPT/etc.] in the writing of this code. Specifically, I encountered the following issue: [state problem addressed here], and with Generative AI's help, I learned to resolve it by [state how problem addressed here].”
:::
:::
